note: H188: attack on S91 -- five seats, one computation.

controls.name: C1_reproduces_S91
controls.must_fire_because: arm0 must reproduce S91's committed adjudication and axes through S91's own main()
controls.can_fail_because: any drift between run.py and result.json, or a patch of mine leaking across arms, makes them differ
controls.null_must_contain: an arm0 whose numbers differ from the committed result.json

controls.name: C2_tripwire_is_live
controls.must_fire_because: the negative control must trip the same tripwire, or arm A's silence is an inert probe
controls.can_fail_because: a Tripwire that raised on nothing would let reads_the_agent() return normally
controls.null_must_contain: a worker that reads agent['binary'] and is not caught

controls.name: C3_axis_audit_responds
controls.must_fire_because: collapsing the operator strings to one must move the axis and fire S91's own F3, or arm D1 shows nothing -- an audit that never moves is not an audit
controls.can_fail_because: an axis count hard-wired to 5 would report 5 for the collapsed roster too
controls.null_must_contain: a collapsed roster still reporting operator=5

falsifiers.name: F1_seat_is_read
falsifiers.can_fail_because: execute_job_on_agent reads its `agent` argument for any of the 74 jobs
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a seat read on at least one job
falsifiers.refutes: that S91's five seats are one computation
falsifiers.fires_when: execute_job_on_agent reads its `agent` argument for any of the 74 jobs
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F2_digest_is_a_result
falsifiers.can_fail_because: S91's corpus digests are not ~injective on source, or the real chain's committed hashes do not collapse
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a real chain whose distinct-hash count equals its job count
falsifiers.refutes: that S91 hashes job INPUTS rather than reduction RESULTS
falsifiers.fires_when: S91's corpus digests are not ~injective on source, or the real chain's committed hashes do not collapse
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F3_pin_is_checked
falsifiers.can_fail_because: patching PIN_F001 to a wrong value moves valid_accepted or divergences
falsifiers.null_must_contain: an adjudication that differs under a wrong pin
falsifiers.refutes: that F001/F002 'pin match' is expected == expected
falsifiers.fires_when: patching PIN_F001 to a wrong value moves valid_accepted or divergences
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: S91's worker reads its seat, or its pin is really compared, or its axis audit measures something observed
